findings: Non-blocking: the testimonials 'Rating' column (index 3) is left sortable but holds star-glyph strings (★★★☆☆), so its header sorts lexically on the glyphs rather than by numeric rating. Add index 3 to that table's data-dt-nosort or render a numeric value if numeric sort is desired.

Non-blocking: deep JS-runtime behavior (modal open/close/focus/Esc/backdrop, pagination re-render, delete on a filtered or page-2 row) is design-verified and build-verified but not browser-executed per the coder's own note. A manual smoke pass is the right final gate before release.
